model.recipe: One immutable count-unit recipe version with exactly two input and two output roles plus a fixed positive duration.
model.run: draft, scheduled, or cancelled. The planned end is computed as planned_start plus immutable duration while creating managed role rows; the run exposes no writable end field.
model.scheduled_inputs: Each input role reduces free available at planned_start, reduces physical quantity at end, leaves available unchanged at end, and adds gross input at end for the pre-end physical stock guard.
model.outputs: Each output role adds physical quantity and free availability at end and owns a capacity root consumed by a typed stock_out link.
model.cancellation: Cancellation before or at start removes effects. Cancellation after start and before end releases the hold at cancellation time without physical consumption or output. Cancellation at or after end rejects.
model.shared_stock_writers: Stock movements, purchase receipts, and H7 assembly input/output now add quantity and available deltas together; stock quantity minimum remains physical-only and available has a separate complete-time nonnegative guard.

coverage: Draft has no managed children or stock/reservation/gross-demand effect.
Overlapping reservations beyond opening availability reject in both source ID orders with complete snapshots unchanged.
Ordinary stock_out cannot spend held availability; same-account output cannot fund gross input at the run end.
Mid-run as-of quantity and available are independently checked; exact-end input consumption, output grant, and reservation coalescing match a source-row oracle.
Start-date edits refresh stable child end dates; earlier opening stock reduction/deletion revalidates and rejects atomically when it strands a scheduled run.
Before-start, exact-start, and after-start cancellation behavior and as-of totals are checked; at/after-end cancellation rejects.

Typed production output stock_out usage succeeds within capacity. Run quantity reduction, cancellation, deletion, consumer unlink, and output-date movement that strand usage reject with full snapshot equality.
Duplicate run retry and repeated scheduling preserve stable managed child identities and all roots.
Independent oracles rebuild physical quantity, free availability, gross input, and output-use capacity from source rows.
engine_observations: On SurrealDB 3.2.0, marking the run end projection READONLY made a valid planned_start edit fail during rebase_refresh because an internal refresh attempted to update a readonly field.

A writable VALUE projection could be overridden directly by a caller. The production route therefore stores no run-level end_at; schemafull rejects an injected end_at, and managed role dates are computed from planned_start plus immutable duration.
limitations: This is a bounded integration fixture, not a production migration or a general recipe language.
No valuation, work-in-progress cost, workforce, arbitrary recipe DAG, or variable-duration route is included.

Gross-input capacity is aggregated per stock account at the exact completion timestamp against strictly pre-end physical stock; this does not trace individual lots or define a generalized source-selection model.
Only one optional production output reference is supported per stock_out, and a stock_out cannot link both H7 and H8 output rows.
